final_answer:
**Apple's gross margin for fiscal year 2024 was $180,683 million (~$180.7 billion).**

Supporting detail:
- Total net sales of $391,035 million less cost of sales of $210,352 million yields gross margin of $180,683 million for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 [DOC-1].
- This equates to a gross margin rate of approximately 46.2% ($180,683 ÷ $391,035) [DOC-1].

Comparability note: The question asks only for the FY2024 figure, which is stated directly and requires no cross-period adjustment. If comparing to the prior year ($169,148 million on $383,285 million of net sales, a 44.1% rate) [DOC-1], note that the two periods end on different dates (September 28, 2024 vs. September 30, 2023), so the fiscal periods are not of identical length; Apple's fiscal calendar periodically includes a 53-week year, which can affect year-over-year comparisons of absolute dollar amounts.

ANSWER: $180,683 million (approximately $180.7 billion), a gross margin rate of ~46.2%
